text: Le vent se lève sur les dunes. Personne ne sait d'où viennent les ombres, mais elles finissent toujours par rentrer. Asseyez-vous, et écoutez bien.
instruct: An old male storyteller with a deep, low-pitched, slightly husky voice. He speaks slowly and calmly, almost in a murmur, with a mysterious tone and a dry sense of humour, like an old desert nomad telling a tale by the fire. Native French speaker.
